summary: Add zero-call cloning and deterministic same-run/snapshot/question-set comparison for frozen Reference evaluations under different model profiles.
decision_refs: The advanced-model reference must be compared against the same immutable local evidence and questions
CIRP is the management and audit layer and must not infer which model answer is correct
Clone and comparison are local management operations and cannot authorize model dispatch
approval_evidence: The active user goal directs continued construction of the advanced-model Reference framework while retaining existing features.
known_limitations: Clone and comparison prepare and inspect an A/B benchmark but do not execute a model or prove answer quality.
Only the newest 20 project evaluations exposed by the bounded browser list are selectable in the current UI; the API accepts any exact accessible evaluation IDs.
Sequential model execution remains browser-driven and explicitly confirmed; server-side unattended execution is not included.
